item.title: OCEAN BIOMES Add-On 1.1
item.creator: HorizonBlocks
item.description:
Add new BIOMES, ANIMALS and STRUCTURES to the oceans! „Ocean Biomes Add-On“ takes your oceans to a new level! 

+ 3 Ocean BIOMES 
+ 60+ Aquatic Animals 
+ STRUCTURES
+ 65+ ITEMS, BLOCKS, ORES, FOOD and TOOLS 
+ Add-On
item.changelog:
- Added Sunken Caves biome
- Added Chrysocolla along with a complete set of tools

- Added new ocean animals

- Reworked diving suit

faqEntries.heading: How do I obtain the OCEAN BIOMES Guide Book?
faqEntries.content: Craft it with one Book and one Kelp. Place the Guide Book on a block to open it.

faqEntries.heading: Where can I find the new ocean biomes?
faqEntries.content: All new Ocean Biomes generate in Overworld oceans except frozen oceans.

faqEntries.heading: Can the biome fog and particles be changed?
faqEntries.content: Yes. Use the VFX Settings item to adjust the custom particles and fog used by the new regions and vanilla oceans.

howToEntries.heading: Explore new Ocean Biomes
howToEntries.content: Search the Overworld's oceans for the Volcano Reef, Mushroom Abyss, Toxic Badlands and Sunken Caves. Each region contains unique terrain, structures, creatures, hazards and resources.

howToEntries.heading: Craft Diving Suits
howToEntries.content:
Craft Diving Suit armor to increase your air supply. Wearing a complete set also grants Night Vision and protects you from poison in the Toxic Badlands. 

Hint: Upgrade to the Cave Diving Suit for even more air capacity.

howToEntries.heading: Discover ocean wildlife
howToEntries.content:
Encounter dozens of aquatic creatures throughout the new regions and vanilla oceans. Some are peaceful, while sharks, poisonous animals, and powerful biome predators make exploration dangerous.

Hint: In the Mushroom Abyss, you'll find a giant jellyfish that can be tamed and ridden by up to four players. Tame this creature with Oxy Berries and equip it with a saddle.

howToEntries.heading: Transportation of Ocean Animals
howToEntries.content:
Interact with animals by holding a Water Bucket to capture and transport many aquatic creatures. 

Hint: Only small and medium-sized neutral and friendly mobs can be transported in a bucket.

howToEntries.heading: Trade with the Oceanograph
howToEntries.content:
Locate the Oceanograph to exchange creature drops, seafood, and other discoveries for Emeralds. The trader can also offer useful resources such as Oxy Berries, Uranium materials, and filled Magma Pearls.

Hint: You'll find the oceanographer on a raft floating on the water's surface.
